Computations corroborate, not replace, these classical theorems.

value.rationale: A complete integral codimension-two and middle-lattice classification of a recent rational Fano fourfold, including an unrecorded nontrivial odd-degree torsion group and its perfect linking with algebraic two-torsion. This resolves a concrete false zero entry in the primary public cohomology table and distinguishes high-degree torsion in rational Fano varieties from degree-three birational obstruction; significance rests on this natural moduli-family invariant rather than a general blow-up lemma.
